description: Branch R-SORT-3 Shortened-key collisions, locating the length (public side). On an ACCDB, the sharp s repeated h times + 'x' and + 'y' for h = 200, 240, 245, 248, 250, 251, 252, 253 and 254 (so the key is h + 1 units; the pair k = 0 to 8 has IDs 2k+1 and 2k+2), in L (non-unique IX_K built first) and in an unindexed copy L0. Reads the equality join A.K = B.K where A.ID < B.ID, the join A.K < B.K where A.ID + 1 = B.ID and GROUP BY K (first ID, count) on both, plus the IX_K walk. Asks at which h the first colliding pair appears and whether the answer is the same with and without the index.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE L (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255))
CREATE TABLE L0 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L0 PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255))
INSERT INTO L0 (ID, K) SELECT ID, K FROM L
SELECT A.ID, B.ID FROM L AS A INNER JOIN L AS B ON A.K = B.K WHERE A.ID < B.ID
SELECT A.ID, B.ID FROM L AS A INNER JOIN L AS B ON A.K < B.K WHERE A.ID + 1 = B.ID
SELECT MIN(ID), COUNT(*) FROM L GROUP BY K ORDER BY K
SELECT A.ID, B.ID FROM L0 AS A INNER JOIN L0 AS B ON A.K = B.K WHERE A.ID < B.ID

SELECT MIN(ID), COUNT(*) FROM L0 GROUP BY K ORDER BY K
